subject: Re: Evidence curation sprint & log retention bandwidth upgrade
messages:
From: Alice Ramos <alice.ramos@acme-gaming.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.com
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2027-09-12T16:14:00Z
Subject: SOC2 re-attestation scope + log retention bandwidth needs for renewal

Hi Soojin,

Hope you’re well. As part of Acme Gaming’s upcoming vendor recertification (renewal due 10/10), our security team needs to validate a few things that will impact our contract renewal and capacity commitments:

- Confirmed log retention windows (current ask: 13 months for audit logs, 25 months for transaction logs).
- Evidence upload throughput needed for our bulk transfer (we estimate ~1.8TB/day for 3 days).
- A compact SOC2 evidence set and a lookup matrix that maps Redwood endpoints/service names to our control IDs.

We’d like to run an \"evidence curation sprint\" next week to collect and verify artifacts. Can Redwood provide:
1) A short runbook for S3 transfer (credentials, path, TTL) we can hand to our infra team.
2) A retention matrix mapping (CSV/Excel) and sample logs for format validation.
3) Confirmation of any temporary capacity uplift you can commit for the 72-hour bulk upload window (we’ll likely need burst GPUs/ingress allowances).

I’ve attached our SOC2-SC-questions.pdf and a rough timeline. Procurement is copied for visibility on PO timing.

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call if helpful.

—Alice Ramos
Security Program Manager, Acme Gaming
security@acme-gaming.com

Attachments: SOC2-SC-questions.pdf (pdf)
From: soojin_lee@redwood.com
To: Alice Ramos <alice.ramos@acme-gaming.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2027-09-12T20:05:00Z
Subject: Re: SOC2 re-attestation scope + log retention bandwidth needs for renewal

Alice — thanks for the clear ask and the attachment. We can absolutely support an evidence curation sprint. High-level answers and next steps below: 

1) S3 transfer runbook: we will create a short runbook and provide a pre-signed bucket path with TTL for your infra team. I’ll include an ACL recipe for limited write + lifecycle rules.

2) Retention mapping: we have a retention matrix template (log-retention-matrix.xlsx) — I’ll populate it mapping Redwood service names to our SOC2 control references and sample file paths.

3) Temporary capacity uplift: we can offer a 3-day ingress uplift window with a target of 2.5TB/day to give headroom. Can you confirm exact ingest start date and desired time zone? We’ll need a PO or written approval to schedule GPU/network burst allocation.

Proposed schedule:
- Wed 9/15: short kickoff (30m) to confirm artifacts and S3 details
- Thu 9/16 – Sat 9/18: evidence curation upload window (you choose start)
- Mon 9/20: shared review of curated items and missing artifacts

Action items for you: confirm ingest start date + provide contact for infra who will run the transfer.

I’ve looped in Karthik for the PO/terms impact and Marissa for the attestations and timeline.

Best,
So.

Soojin Lee
Senior Security & Compliance Program Manager | Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com

Attachments: log-retention-matrix.xlsx (stub)
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: soojin_lee@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Cc: Alice Ramos <alice.ramos@acme-gaming.com>
Date: 2027-09-13T15:22:00Z
Subject: Re: SOC2 re-attestation scope + log retention bandwidth needs for renewal

Looping in Laura for billing / contract language. A few internal notes:

- PO / terms: If Acme wants the 2.5TB/day uplift for 3 days, we’ll treat this as a one-time capacity uplift. Standard approach: draft an amendment that adds a short-term capacity addendum and a one-time usage credit in lieu of permanent price changes.
- SLA/Retention: Any change to long-term retention defaults (beyond our standard 12 months) needs a written amendment to the MSA — Laura, can you prepare a draft amendment that allows 25-month transaction log retention for Acme with the appropriate cost pass-through?
- Evidence handling: Marissa — can you own the curation sprint on Redwood's side, review samples as they arrive, and label confirmed artifacts with our control IDs?

I’ll hold the uplift internally pending signed PO or signed amendment. Soojin — feel free to send the kickoff invite for 9/15.

—Karthik
VP, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
From: Alice Ramos <alice.ramos@acme-gaming.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@acme-gaming.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: 2027-09-14T09:03:00Z
Subject: Re: SOC2 re-attestation scope + log retention bandwidth needs for renewal

Thanks Soojin and Karthik — we appreciate the flexibility. Confirming:

- Ingest window: Mon 9/20 02:00 UTC start (72 hours) — aim to complete by Thu 9/23 02:00 UTC.
- Requested uplift: 2.5TB/day.
- PO: procurement will issue a PO today that references a capacity uplift and a retention amendment (we’ll sign both).
- Infra lead: I'm assigning Marco Lopez (marco.lopez@acme-gaming.com) to run the transfers. He’ll need the S3 path + runbook.

I’m attaching a short transfer instructions stub (s3-access-instructions.txt) and procurement will follow with the PO number.

—Alice

From: soojin_lee@redwood.com

Subject: Re: SOC2 re-attestation scope + log retention bandwidth needs for renewal — kickoff + action items

Thanks all — confirmed. Quick summary and attachments so everyone has a single source of truth:

Kickoff: Wed 9/15 16:00 PDT / Thu 9/16 00:00 UTC (30m) — invite sent.

What Redwood will deliver before ingest start (Mon 9/20 02:00 UTC):
- Pre-signed S3 path (TTL 7 days) and ACL recipe for uploads — will email access details to Marco directly.
- Completed retention matrix (attached: log-retention-matrix.xlsx) mapping Redwood control IDs to your SOC2 questions.
- On-call support during 72-hour window (Marissa will be primary).
- Draft amendment and PO acceptance process: Laura will send a draft amendment today to procurement and copy Karthik.

Acme action items:
- Procurement to send PO referencing DEAL-8791-RW and the 3-day uplift (procurement@acme-gaming.com).
- Marco to confirm S3 transfer test time and validate sample file format by 9/18 EOD.

Attachments included: log-retention-matrix.xlsx, SOC2-SC-questions.pdf (from Acme), s3-access-instructions.txt (from Acme).

If anything changes to the ingest window, flag it ASAP so we can reschedule capacity. Otherwise we’ll proceed with the uplift reservations once we receive the PO.

Best,
So.

Soojin Lee
Senior Security & Compliance Program Manager | Redwood Inference
